entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: Young Argivian nobleman and human wizard appointed to hunt Phyrexian sleeper agents who was himself a sleeper agent.

entities.name: Compleated Stenn
entities.description: Compleated Phyrexian creature Stenn became, killed by Karn and Jaya.

entities.name: Darien XLVIII
entities.description: King of New Argive who appointed Stenn.

entities.name: Shanid
entities.description: Sent by Stenn to the Balduvian Steppe to root out sleepers.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Planeswalker who revealed the Phyrexian threat and killed compleated Stenn.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Jaya
entities.description: Traveled with Stenn to Argivia and helped kill him.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Dominaria whose sleeper agents Stenn hunted.

entities.name: Ice Rime Hills
entities.description: Region where Keld and Benalia were at war.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Party to the peace summit whose knights included sleeper agents.

entities.name: Argivia
entities.description: City Stenn traveled to and infected with Phyrexians.

events.summary: King Darien appoints Stenn to find Phyrexian sleeper agents, and Stenn dispatches Shanid to the Balduvian Steppe.
events.quote: he was appointed by King Darien XLVIII to discover Phyrexian sleeper agents

events.summary: Stenn presides over the Oyster Bay peace summit, interrupted when Karn and Teferi reveal the Phyrexian threat and Benalish knights are exposed as sleeper agents.
events.quote: The summit was interrupted when the planeswalkers Karn and Teferi revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion

events.summary: In Argivia, Stenn is revealed to be a sleeper agent who had been infecting the city with Phyrexians.
events.quote: he was revealed to be a sleeper agent himself, having secretly been infecting the city with Phyrexians

events.summary: The compleated Stenn is killed by Karn and Jaya.
events.quote: The compleated creature that once had been Stenn was killed by Karn and Jaya.

relations.note: He did the bidding of his king.
relations.quote: stopping at nothing to do the bidding of his king

relations.note: Karn and Jaya killed the compleated Stenn.
relations.quote: was killed by Karn and Jaya
